text: Rohan, welcome to June. We are moving into Plan v1.1 today. Main focus: consistency, BP monitoring three times a week, and pushing HRV above 55ms.
Sounds good. Should I continue with the two weekly strength sessions from last month?
Yes, keep them. We'll now add one optional mobility-focused session on weekends. Nothing heavy, just 15 minutes of movement to improve recovery.
BP today was 128/82. Better than last week's average.
That's encouraging. Let's track this trend through the month. If you stay below 130 consistently, that's a positive sign.
HRV today was 58ms, recovery 62%. First time above 55 in weeks.
Excellent. That shows the consistency is paying off. Keep the breathing sessions daily — they're working.
Had a late dinner and drinks with friends tonight. Sleep will probably be short.
That's fine occasionally. Hydrate before bed, and tomorrow stick to lighter meals to balance it out.
Rohan, we've scheduled your mid-point blood panel for June 17. This will help us see early shifts in lipids and ApoB.
Okay. Same fasting requirement as last time?
Yes, 12 hours fasting. Water is fine.
Rohan, your June panel shows ApoB has come down slightly from April, lipids are trending in the right direction. hs-CRP remains stable.
That's good news. What should I focus on next?
We'll tighten up evening meals — lighter dinners with more protein, fewer carbs. This supports lipid management.
BP average this week was 126/80. HRV is hovering around 57-60ms. Feels steadier.
Great progress. Consistency is showing results. Keep logging daily metrics.
As we close Month 3, we'll evolve to Plan v1.2 for July. Slightly more structured training and refined nutrition, since you're adapting well.
Understood. I feel more in rhythm now. Ready for the next step.
